t: The Phoenix of NixOS: An X11 System Automation Blueprint
s: This article details the recovery of NixOS system automation, specifically restoring the `autognome.py` script for multi-screen setup after a crash, by re-establishing core utilities like prompt management and system configuration via Gemini CLI directives.
sub: NixOS system recovery and X11 automation with `autognome.py`
Configuring system packages (`wmctrl`, `xdotool`) and shell aliases for `autognome.py` via Gemini CLI
Conceptual parallels: Confidence Engineering, BJJ vs. Kung Fu AI interaction, Block Universe and NixOS generations
